items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: We had a cook, two of them in fact, that followed each other, Amotin and Adele.

ctx.x: Although the Catholic faith regards the age of reason at age seven, the memory dates way before that. That's been proven. How far back, I don't know. I'll tell you another thing that I remember so distinctly, and I was age four then. The people next door were the Stevens, Harry Stevens, that had this, what do you call it, clothing store, Stevens on Canal Street. Oh, yeah. Next to us, and in the back of our yard, they had their stable. And there was a beautiful stallion that they had, one of them used to drive.…
I looked down a few minutes.
